"My Shop Master/My Shop Buyer":
"Earning the Title My Shop Master (マイショップマスター) will unlock the following feature:

・Editing your My Shop Advertisement"

"Earning the Title My Shop Buyer (マイショップバイヤー) will unlock the following features:

・Search for shops

This search will only return players who have earned the Title My Shop Master."

"Also, when a buyer who has My Shop Buyer interacts with a seller who has My Shop Master, the following features become available:

・Viewing \"My Shop Details\" from the product listing
・Being able to see the buyer's Player ID on the \"Sales Confirmation\" list
・Sending a Good Job to the seller when buying a product"
